name: music-xl-s42
style: warm indie pop, acoustic guitar, female vocal, 100 bpm
lyrics:
[verse]
Morning light on the harbour wall
Boats come home and the seagulls call
[chorus]
Hold the tide, hold it still
I will wait by the window sill

texts.plan.style: A gentle and serene acoustic folk piece centered around a clean, fingerpicked acoustic guitar playing a steady, arpeggiated pattern. A soft, breathy female lead vocal delivers a lullaby-like melody with a clear, gentle tone. The chorus introduces lush, layered vocal harmonies that create an ethereal, choir-like texture, enhanced by a spacious reverb. The arrangement is minimalist and intimate, with a brief instrumental section featuring wordless vocalizations before a final verse and a concluding, resonant guitar chord.
